recognize_zh: A 圖頰黏膜可見蒼白、緊繃的纖維化條帶（細箭頭）與白色網狀角化（粗箭頭）；B 圖口周皮膚緊繃、張口受限並伴色素沉著，這些口腔與口周硬化變化是慢性移植物抗宿主病（cGVHD）的硬化型表現。
features: A: pale, taut buccal mucosa with fibrotic bands (thin arrows) near the retromolar region
A: white reticular/hyperkeratotic lichenoid change on the buccal mucosa (thick arrow)
A: patchy erythema of the mucosa and lips; mouth opening assisted by a retractor
B: perioral skin sclerosis with tight, thinned lips and reduced oral aperture
B: mottled perioral hyperpigmentation; clinical photographs only
describe_en: Composite clinical photographs of orofacial sclerotic chronic graft-versus-host disease. Panel A shows the buccal mucosa with pale, taut fibrotic bands (thin arrows) and white reticular hyperkeratotic lichenoid change (thick arrow), with patchy erythema. Panel B shows sclerosis of the perioral skin with tight, thinned lips, a reduced oral aperture, and mottled perioral hyperpigmentation. Together these findings indicate mucosal and perioral skin sclerosis that can cause restricted mouth opening (microstomia/trismus), consistent with sclerotic chronic GVHD, often in combination with lichenoid oral disease.

ddx.vs: Submucous fibrosis produces similar blanched fibrous bands but occurs with areca (betel) nut chewing and no transplantation history.
Systemic sclerosis causes perioral furrowing and microstomia with Raynaud phenomenon and specific autoantibodies, without lichenoid oral mucosal changes or transplant history.
Lichen planus shows reticular white striae but does not produce mucosal fibrotic bands or perioral skin sclerosis.
Radiation-induced trismus follows head and neck irradiation and is confined to the radiation field.

captions: A: Buccal mucosal fibrotic bands (thin arrows) and lichenoid hyperkeratosis (thick arrow)
B: Perioral sclerosis with restricted mouth opening and hyperpigmentation
